application:business-rule:charge-idempot.decision: The client's key is required (no str(id(order)) fallback) and bound to one order; the first attempt's key is written before the gateway is called and reused on every retry, so one order makes at most one gateway charge; an already-paid order is never charged again whatever key is sent

application:business-rule:gateway-timeou.decision: On a gateway timeout, retry once with the same key (the gateway is idempotent by key); if the outcome is still unknown the order stays pending with its attempt key and the error is raised; the next pay (any key) or the charge.succeeded webhook completes it without a second charge

application:business-rule:webhook-idempo.decision: Each event id is recorded in the same atomic write as its effect; a redelivered event does nothing; charge.succeeded and charge.refunded are handled by type; unknown types and orders are ignored; no backwards moves

application:workflow:cancel-paid-order.decision: Cancelling a pending order ends in 'cancelled'; cancelling a paid order refunds its charge through the gateway exactly once and ends in 'refunded' with one ledger refund; cancelling a cancelled or refunded order is a no-op

database:field-meaning:order-payment-sta.decision: One status field with C's four values (pending, paid, cancelled, refunded) and an enforced transition table; A's paid flag is not stored (paid means status == 'paid')

database:atomicity:write-failure.decision: Every state change is one atomic store write (order, ledger entry, processed event id together); before any gateway call the intent (attempt key or refund intent) is written first, so when that write fails (StoreError) nothing is changed and the gateway is not called

application:business-rule:renewal-duplic.decision: One order per subscription id per period: renewing again for the same period returns the existing order

database:duplicate-entity:order.decision: Merge A:Order and C:Order into one Order (the user's task.md describes one order flowing from subscription to payment to cancellation); fields: id, customer, amount_cents (from A:Order.amount), status (from C:Order.status, replaces A:Order.paid), charge_id (from A), attempt_key, refund_state, refund_id

database:field-meaning:amount-units.decision: Integer minor units: amount_cents on orders, price_cents on subscriptions; non-integer, boolean or non-positive amounts are rejected

database:unknown-type:order.primary-key.decision: Neither source has a key (in-memory dicts); the unified Order key is a string 'ord_<n>' generated by the app

migration:order.decision: Plan approved (A.Order.amount number to integer cents); see design/migration-plan.md. No source data exists (in-memory dicts only), so nothing is run; running any import later needs its own migration approval

migration:renewal.decision: Plan approved (B.Subscription.customer any to text and price number to integer cents); see design/migration-plan.md. No source data exists (in-memory dicts only), so nothing is run; running any import later needs its own migration approval
